kunAccountWaitingTitle: Finish signing in in your browser
kunAccountWaitingBody: The sign-in page is open in your default browser. Kun updates on its own when you're done.
kunAccountWaitingHint: The page works for 5 minutes. Closing this panel won't stop sign-in.
kunAccountWelcomeBody: {{email}} is now signed in to Kun on this computer.
kunAccountManageHint: Opens the Kun account center in your browser
kunAccountManageFailed: Couldn't open your browser. Try again in a moment.
kunAccountRefreshed: Your profile is up to date
kunAccountSignOutHint: Only signs out Kun on this computer
kunAccountKeychainNote: Sign-in is encrypted in your macOS keychain
kunAccountCredentialNote: Sign-in is encrypted in your system credential store
kunAccountSyncWarning: Couldn't sync your profile. Your account still works.
kunAccountErrorNetworkTitle: Can't reach the Kun account service
kunAccountErrorNetworkBody: Check your network or proxy settings, then try again.
kunAccountErrorServiceBody: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
kunAccountErrorTimeoutBody: The sign-in page expired after 5 minutes. Just try again.
kunAccountErrorCancelledBody: Authorization was declined in the browser. Try again whenever you're ready.
kunAccountErrorExpiredBody: For your security, please sign in again. Your local chats and settings are untouched.
kunAccountErrorPortBody: Another Kun may be signing in. Close it or wait a moment, then try again.
kunAccountErrorKeychainBody: Kun encrypts your sign-in with the macOS keychain. Unlock it, then try again.
kunAccountErrorCredentialBody: Kun needs your system's credential store to encrypt your sign-in. Make sure it's available, then try again.
kunAccountErrorConfigTitle: This version can't sign in yet
kunAccountErrorConfigBody: Account sign-in isn't fully configured. Update Kun and try again.
